Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft + next steps

Hi Sara —

Great to meet with you and the AuroraTech team earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: low-latency customer-facing recommendations across web + mobile.
- Key constraints: PII minimization, in-region hosting (US), and 99.9% uptime SLA target for peak hours.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 latency for /generate, 25% cost reduction vs current infra baseline, and SOC2 compliance evidence for security team.

Per our ask on the call, I attached an initial MAP (AuroraTech-MAP-draft.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and dependencies. High-level proposed timeline options are: 30 days (accelerated), 45 days (recommended), or 60 days (conservative).

Can you confirm: 1) preferred target close window (30/45/60 days), 2) the stakeholders who should be owners for each milestone (security, infra, procurement, product), and 3) any dependencies we missed (procurement lead time, legal redlines, SOC2 checklist items)?

I copied Nikhil (solutions engineer) to help with technical milestones. If 45 days works, I propose a short MAP review on Tue, Aug 18 at 10:00am PT to align owners and finalize dates.

Attachments: AuroraTech-MAP-draft.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
